headline: Medical Technologist, RMT
summary: Registered medical technologist with four years in hospital and diagnostic laboratories in Isabela. I run hematology, clinical chemistry and microbiology tests, maintain and calibrate analysers, and follow biosafety rules strictly. I also help keep the laboratory's quality records ready for licensing inspections.

experience.title: Medical Technologist
bullets: Run about 150 tests a shift in hematology and chemistry on automated analysers.
Process cultures and sensitivity tests in the microbiology section.
Do daily maintenance and quality control, and log every calibration and fault.
Train new staff in specimen labelling and biosafety cabinet use.

experience.title: Medical Technologist
bullets: Collected and processed blood and urine samples for outpatients and company annual physicals.
Released results in the laboratory information system after supervisor review.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Medical Technology
education.school: Cagayan Valley College of Allied Health
notes: Internship at a tertiary hospital laboratory
